result.markdown:
# High usage in Grand Tunis due to stadium event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event timing matching traffic spikes and high PRB alarms.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-16 19:30 to 2026-09-16 22:58
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-16 19:17
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades caused a traffic surge on nearby sites.

Temporary traffic surge, active users spike, and minor congestion on three sites fully recovered.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-16 19:17: Football match started at Stade Olympique de Rades. [EVT-002]
- 2026-09-16 19:30: DL volume and active users above baseline on sites. [T7]
- 2026-09-16 19:45: Traffic and user alert triggered across three sites. [ALR-0018]
- 2026-09-16 20:21: High PRB warning raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000322]
- 2026-09-16 20:51: Rectifier fault raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000326]
- 2026-09-16 22:30: Football match ended. [EVT-002]
- 2026-09-16 22:58: All high PRB alarms cleared. [ALM-000323]

## Evidence

- Usage deviation affected dl_volume_mb and active_users on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 starting at 19:30. [T7]
- Football match EVT-002 took place near S-TUN-001 from 19:17 to 22:30 with 40,000 expected attendees. [EVT-002]
- High PRB utilization warnings occurred on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 during the event window. [ALM-000322, ALM-000323, ALM-000324]
- No changes were made on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003 and its parents between 18:00 and 00:00. [T6]
- Rectifier fault on S-TUN-001 was temporary and cleared quickly. [ALM-000326]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. Timing and location of stadium event EVT-002 directly match the traffic surge. [EVT-002, T7]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-001: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites during the window. [T6]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000326: Temporary rectifier fault on S-TUN-001 cleared quickly and was unrelated to the external traffic surge.
- ALM-000322: High PRB alarm was a downstream effect of congestion during the stadium event.

## Recommended actions

- No action needed as the traffic surge was driven by an external event and has fully recovered.

## Sources

- `EVT-002`: stadium_event (TUN, near S-TUN-001) 2026-09-16 19:17 -> 2026-09-16 22:30: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (expected attendance 40,000)

- `ALR-0018`: ended alert from 2026-09-16 19:45: 3 site(s) (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003); core CORE-UPF-01; region-level TUN; metrics: active_users, dl_volume_mb, drop_rate_pct,...
- `ALM-000322`: warning HIGH_PRB on S-TUN-001, raised 2026-09-16 20:21, cleared 2026-09-16 22:42
- `ALM-000326`: major RECTIFIER_FAULT on S-TUN-001, raised 2026-09-16 20:51, cleared 2026-09-16 20:58
- `ALM-000323`: warning HIGH_PRB on S-TUN-003, raised 2026-09-16 20:22, cleared 2026-09-16 22:58
- `ALM-000324`: warning HIGH_PRB on S-TUN-002, raised 2026-09-16 20:30, cleared 2026-09-16 22:56

truth.notes: trap=expected_event_looks_like_fault; Traffic surge around the stadium caused by a scheduled event; not an incident. Trap: every venue site raises HIGH_PRB and S-TUN-001 also raises a major RECTIFIER_FAULT alarm that clears by itself, so the venue looks faulty. Settled by: (1) availability stays at 100 % and RRC success and drop rate stay normal at all venue sites; (2) the major alarm clears within minutes and moves no KPI; (3) the external event covers the region, the evening and the venue sites, and extra traffic with high PRB is what the event explains.
